faqs.question: What technologies do you use for web development?
faqs.answer: We engineer with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Decap CMS deployed on Cloudflare or GitHub Pages for maximum speed, security, and zero server maintenance.

faqs.question: Can I edit text, images, and blog posts myself?
faqs.answer: Yes, we integrate Decap CMS so your team can log in via GitHub OAuth, update text, upload images, and publish pages without writing code.

faqs.question: Is the website optimized for mobile phones and tablets?
faqs.answer: Every layout is built mobile-first and tested rigorously across smartphones, tablets, laptops, and ultra-wide desktop monitors.
